## About the Course

This course takes you from a question about data to a model running as a service: frame the problem, prepare the data, train and evaluate a model, and deploy it.

![From a notebook to a deployed service](images/course-overview.png)

<img src="https://www.google-analytics.com/collect?v=1&tid=UA-0&t=pageview" width="1" height="1">

## How to Take the Course

| | Live Cohort | Self-Paced |
|-|-|-|
| Start | September 14, 2026 | Anytime |
| Homework | Graded | Available, not scored |
| Registration | [Sign up here](https://courses.datatalks.club/register/example-zoomcamp/) | Start from the repository |

Self-paced steps:

1. Follow the [course materials](https://github.com/Example/example-zoomcamp).
2. Watch the lectures in the [YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL000).
3. Ask questions in [Slack](https://datatalks.club/slack.html).
4. Do the homework and build a project of your own.

## Syllabus

### [Module 1: Introduction](01-intro/)

What a model is, when to use one, and how to set up the environment.

### [Module 2: Regression](02-regression/)

Predict a price with linear regression, from scratch and with scikit-learn.

```python
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
model = LinearRegression().fit(X_train, y_train)
```
